decisions.decision: readline/promises replaced with callback-based readline + line-buffer pattern
decisions.rationale: readline/promises silently drops question() promises when stdin closes (piped EOF). Line-buffer pattern pre-captures all 'line' events so piped input is never lost.

decisions.decision: process.exit() replaced with writeSync + exitCode + stdin.destroy() + return for async Commander early exit
decisions.rationale: process.exit() from inside async action handler produces exit code 13 (Unfinished Top-Level Await) and drops buffered stderr.

decisions.decision: chmod +x appended to build script (tsc && chmod +x dist/cli/index.js)
decisions.rationale: tsc outputs non-executable files; npm bin requires executable bit for global install to work.
Guard all prepare scripts against devDep-absent installs (npm install -g, --omit=dev, CI production builds).
